gappers.catalyst: Jefferies downgraded BKSY from Buy to Hold (PT maintained at $50) ahead of Aug 6 Q2 earnings.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Jefferies cut BlackSky from Buy to Hold while keeping its $50 price target, shifting sentiment lower right before the company's Q2 2026 earnings (Aug 6, BMO). Space stocks broadly have been under pressure as investor attention rotates toward SpaceX-adjacent names and the UFO space ETF crosses $1B AUM.
gappers.why: A rating cut this close to earnings removes a bullish analyst voice and triggers de-risking from momentum holders; sector-wide rotation away from smaller space plays compounds the outflow.
gappers.impact: Reads as headline/analyst-driven on an already unprofitable name (TTM operating cash flow -$57.9M, ROE -33.8%, P/S 8.2x). Volume at the snapshot was thin (2,770 sh), so this needs confirmation rather than treating as a repriced trend. Consensus PT ($28.38) still implies upside from $21.68 - the drop could fade if the Aug 6 print reassures, or extend if it disappoints.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM - single-analyst downgrade pre-earnings, no structural catalyst; the real event is the Aug 6 report, not this dip.
gappers.opportunity_cost: 0 open positions, 0/3 weekly trades used, so nothing to displace. But entering 3 days ahead of an earnings binary on a cash-burning name fails the strategy's no-earnings-binary rule (same rule applied to ON 8/3, MSFT/AMZN 7/31) - a stop tight enough for 2:1 R:R can't realistically hold through the print, so this doesn't clear even before the confluence gate.

gappers.catalyst: Shares slipped as investors weighed a buyback plan and a $61.4M note redemption against weak underlying momentum.
gappers.catalyst_detail: Babcock & Wilcox announced share buybacks and a $61.4M note redemption - capital-return moves that would typically read bullish - but the stock declined anyway as weak momentum dominated the session's reaction.
gappers.why: For a company with negative free cash flow (-$62.2M TTM) and negative book value per share (-$1.16) against $275.9M debt vs $106.6M cash, using cash for buybacks/redemption reads to the market as a liquidity/dilution risk flag rather than a confidence signal, producing selling instead of a pop.
gappers.impact: Fundamentals are stressed (EPS -$0.60, underperforming industry) and consensus analyst price target is $5.75 - well BELOW even the post-gap price - implying the sell-off may continue rather than mean-revert. Aug 10 earnings adds further binary risk on top.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM, and arguably not a long setup at all - the consensus PT sits under spot, so there's no structural bull catalyst here.
gappers.opportunity_cost: 0 open positions, 0/3 weekly trades used - nothing to displace. Not viable as a long regardless: with consensus PT below current price, a long can't clear a sane 2:1 R:R on the available thesis. Strategy is long-only in scope, so this is a pass, not a short candidate.

gappers.catalyst: No negative company-specific catalyst found; same-day coverage instead shows a bullish drone-sector narrative (AeroVironment's strong Q4 sparking a sector rally).
gappers.catalyst_detail: Available research found no negative headline for UMAC. Coverage instead centers on AeroVironment's strong Q4 lifting drone stocks broadly, plus an unrelated Eric Trump-backed robotics startup's AMD chip deal appearing in UMAC's news feed. A separate source showed UMAC actually +1.75% at a different timestamp than the Alpaca premarket snapshot used for this gap_pct.
gappers.why: Catalyst/price-direction mismatch: no bearish driver corroborates the -6.49% print, and premarket volume was thin (4,767 sh), consistent with a thin-liquidity/stale-quote premarket artifact rather than a real repricing event.
gappers.impact: Likely a data artifact given thin volume and the absence of any negative catalyst - needs re-verification against a live quote at/near market open before being treated as a real move.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM - if genuine, no structural catalyst supports holding; if an artifact (more likely), there's nothing to hold. Q2 earnings land Aug 6 (3 days out), adding pre-earnings binary risk either way.
gappers.opportunity_cost: 0 open positions, 0/3 weekly trades used - nothing to displace. Earnings 3 days out makes this an earnings-binary setup regardless of direction, excluded by strategy rule; the catalyst/price mismatch also means confluence's documented-catalyst leg isn't cleanly satisfied. Pass.
